character_system_text.1089:2033:
I must have gotten a little
stronger… Which means,
Trainer…!
character_system_text.1089:2034:
In this condition… I think I can
give this race all I have right now.
I-I'll go and show you…!
character_system_text.1089:10000:
Thank you very much. For
noticing me. And for providing
the things I lacked…
character_system_text.1089:10001:
I… I want to live up to how you
see me. To your expectations……
I really do…
character_system_text.1089:10002:
Because you told me that you
chose me… I… I want to believe
in myself too.
character_system_text.1089:10003:
T-This year… I'll become
someone people look up to…!
For sure… No, definitely!
character_system_text.1089:10004:
Trainer…! Today is Va-
Vale… Valen…… N-No,
sorry, it's nothing…
character_system_text.1089:10005:
C-Ch-Choco!! Be-Because it's
Valentine's…! It's my thanks……
for… everything.
character_system_text.1089:10006: Where should I hang my tanzaku… Somewhere hidden away, out of sight…
character_system_text.1089:10007: T-Trick or Treat. Give candy or— Eek!? No, I didn't mean…! I-I… I was just practicing!
character_system_text.1089:10008:
Our family's Christmas party is
always way too flamboyant.
But every time I try to slip away,
Vivlos finds out…
character_system_text.1089:10009:
Th-The lights along the seaside
are so pretty… I wish I could
have seen them up close…
character_system_text.1089:10010:
What souvenirs should I get…?
Something striking that everyone
likes, maybe… This is so hard……
character_system_text.1089:10012:
I also got you… a present.
I-It's a pretty conch keychain!
It reminded me of your dazzling
eyes…
character_system_text.1089:10013: My parents sent me a gift… I wonder if it's something tasty like last year… hehe.
character_system_text.1089:10014:
A-A birthday present? For me?
You didn't have to… Just hearing
your blessings already made me
so happy…
character_system_text.1089:10015:
A message came by. I-If you're
busy, I can look at it for you…
If you're fine with it, that is…
character_system_text.1089:10016:
Ah, I've gathered the gifts for
you on the desk… All you have
to do is retrieve them.
character_system_text.1089:10017: Hah… mission cleared. …Amazing, there's much more to learn from you.
character_system_text.1089:10018:
An event, huh… I think…
I'll just observe from afar…
character_system_text.1089:10019: An event huh… Looks fun. But joining with a bunch of people… Uugh…
character_system_text.1089:10021: Ah… the Archive level seems to have gone up.
character_system_text.1089:10025:
This badge… I tried sewing it on
after our housemaid taught me…
but it looks a little clumsy,
doesn't it…?
character_system_text.1089:10026:
There's crumbs all over my
hoodie again! Ugh, really…
It's definitely Vivlos' doing.
character_system_text.1089:10027:
When I walk along the shore,
I often start humming…
Since the sound of the waves
will drown out my voice.
character_system_text.1089:20000:
…I must keep moving! Or else
I'll be the only one left behind…
character_system_text.1089:20001:
It's fine, I can still go on.
…I have to.
character_system_text.1089:20002:
Shall we try something new?
I-I feel like I can do it right now…!
character_system_text.1089:20003:
I won't lose to anyone.
At the very least, not in heart…!
character_system_text.1089:20004:
If I can maintain this feeling…
I may be able to get closer to
my sisters…
character_system_text.1089:20005: Mm! I feel better than usual. It's really different when you learn under a Trainer…
character_system_text.1089:20006: Umm… What are we going to do today, Trainer? I'm… prepared.
character_system_text.1089:20007:
I'll do what I can do, one step
at a time…
character_system_text.1089:20008: Haah… Ah! Sorry… I shouldn't be sighing so much.
character_system_text.1089:20009: Uu… I have a feeling it won't go as well as usual…
character_system_text.1089:20010:
No matter what I do… I get
no results. …Maybe I really
am no good.
character_system_text.1089:20011:
I'm truly sorry… Even after you
coached me, I couldn't deliver…
character_system_text.1089:20021:
I need to… gain a lot of race
experience, right? No more
breaks— N-No, it's nothing…!
character_system_text.1089:20022:
Why…? No… No! I don't want
to think like this. I want to win,
I want to be first…!
character_system_text.1089:20023:
Alright. I feel in great condition.
So… I'll throw everything I have
at it… and win!
character_system_text.1089:20024:
Maybe, right now, I could ——
Alright! Trainer, I-I'll be going…!
character_system_text.1089:20025:
In this condition… I think I can
display my very best. I-I'll go
and show you…!
character_system_text.1089:20026:
I've done all sorts of prep.
Now, all that's left… is to
trust in its results, right?
character_system_text.1089:20027:
Hey, let's go over it one more
time… If I'm going to do this,
I want to try all I can until the
very last moment…!
character_system_text.1089:20028:
I must have grown at least
a little… That's why, I'm sure…!
character_system_text.1089:20029:
Stay calm, stay calm…
Remember our training…
character_system_text.1089:20030: My condition…? Umm… I think it's not bad.
character_system_text.1089:20031:
I'm sure I've done all that
I can… Now if only I can
produce the result…
character_system_text.1089:20032:
Everyone here looks strong…
I-I'll think of it as as privilege…
character_system_text.1089:20033:
I'm not feeling well today…
B-But you can never know
the outcome until it's over…!
character_system_text.1089:20034:
My condition… well, it's not
great. But even so, I'll do my
absolute… best…!
character_system_text.1089:20035:
At the very least, with what
I can do now… I hope to
make it till the end…
character_system_text.1089:20036:
I'm still far from my best…
But, I'll at least leave my mark…!
character_system_text.1089:20037:
………Huh? Sorry, I was lost
in thought…
character_system_text.1089:20049:
Had I been alone, I probably
wouldn't have made it this far…
character_system_text.1089:30000: Damn it… Next time for sure…!
character_system_text.1089:30002: Ugh, I need to try even harder…
character_system_text.1089:30003:
I'm so far… away from
everyone else…
character_system_text.1089:30004:
It wasn't anyone else…
It was me! Trainer, I won…!
character_system_text.1089:30005:
I can have a little confidence
today, right…?!
character_system_text.1089:30007:
It's okay to have a little
confidence today, right?
character_system_text.1089:40001:
Even someone like me… Even I…
No matter what, I want to be
"grand"…!!
character_system_text.1089:40003: I have to steel my resolve…!
character_system_text.1089:40004: Haa… Okay, I need to channel my coura— eeh!? W-W-W-Wha… D-Don't look at meee! …uuugh…
character_system_text.1089:60000:
C-Calm down, just do it
like I practiced ——
character_system_text.1089:60001:
Hyping up the crowd…
Can I even do that…?
character_system_text.1089:70000: Someday, I will become a grand Umamusume…!
character_system_text.1089:70001:
I'm still not confident…
B-But I trust you, who
believes in me.
character_system_text.1089:70004:
To think I'm a member of this
academy too… It's still hard
to believe.
character_system_text.1089:70008:
I-It's embarrassing when you
keep staring at me like that…
character_system_text.1089:70009:
I want to become stronger…
to be more worthy of my
racewear.
character_system_text.1089:70010:
I think my ironing skills…
have improved a little?
character_system_text.1089:70014:
I have to get used to singing
as the main star on stage…!
character_system_text.1089:70016: Since it's summer… um, I'll join in…
character_system_text.1089:70017:
I like the design. Whether it
suits me… is another matter.
character_system_text.1089:70018:
I just hope it doesn't
look strange on me…
character_system_text.1089:70019:
Wearing something like this…
is okay once in a while…
character_system_text.1089:70020:
Is it okay… if I go for a short
walk along the shore?
character_system_text.1089:70021:
…Yeah. It's easy to move in
and relaxing…
character_system_text.1089:71004:
To think I'm a part of this
Academy too… I still find
it hard to believe.
character_system_text.1089:71008:
I-It's embarrassing when you
stare at me so much…
character_system_text.1089:71009:
I want to become stronger…
to be more worthy of this
racewear.
character_system_text.1089:71010:
My ironing skills…
have improved, right?
character_system_text.1089:71014:
I have to get used to singing
as the main star on stage…!
character_system_text.1089:71016: As it's summer… um, I guess I should also…
character_system_text.1089:71017:
I like the design. Whether it
suits me… is an entirely
different matter.
character_system_text.1089:71018: I'm glad it doesn't look strange…
character_system_text.1089:71019:
Wearing something like this
once in a while… is alright.
character_system_text.1089:90000: Good morning. U-Um, well, uh… What a nice morning this is!?
character_system_text.1089:90001:
Can I hear about our training
plan now? I'd like to get a rough
idea in my head.
character_system_text.1089:90002:
If I wrote everything from class
down, I'll run out of notebooks
fast… How do others manage…?
character_system_text.1089:90003: Um! I'd like to review my form at lunch… Can you watch the videos with me?
character_system_text.1089:90004:
I had another strange dream.
My jaw felt tired when I woke
up… Haven't I had enough
dreams about food…?
character_system_text.1089:90005: Uu… I mustn't drink too much at night. I don't want to have to get up and confront that thing…
character_system_text.1089:90006:
The newest students seem
really fast… I must work even
harder to keep up.
character_system_text.1089:90007: Aren't you a bit hot in the sun…? Umm… maybe you should wear a hat? It'll be better, I think…
character_system_text.1089:90008:
Scad, mackerel, squid…
Which one should I try fishing
for? …Maybe all of them!
character_system_text.1089:90009:
During winter, when my dad has
free time, we often go ice fishing.
I always look forward to it…
character_system_text.1089:90010: M-Morning…!! N-No, um… I thought I should try a lively greeting for once… or something …… uugh…
character_system_text.1089:90011: Uu… my eyes… The rising sun is just too bright for me without a hat…
character_system_text.1089:90012: I thought about using the fish I caught for a side dish… but… Uu, someone like me can't fully bring out the flavors…
character_system_text.1089:90013:
I-I'm going to raise my hand
in this afternoon's class…!
Even I… should be able to
do that…!
character_system_text.1089:90014:
When I can't sleep? I count
fishes… Like, "caught one fish,
caught two fish…".
character_system_text.1089:90015: Yeah, even when you go to bed early, you wake up and get hungry. ……Eh, is it just me…?
character_system_text.1089:90016: To the juniors, I am a senior… so I should be more… dependable… like, strand straight…! Gah, m-my back… It hurts…
character_system_text.1089:90017:
Volleyball, banana boats,
watermelon splitting… I'm a little
tired, but this kind of summer…
is nice once in a while?
character_system_text.1089:90018:
Autumn melancholy… I can relate
somewhat. When the baseball
season ends in autumn…
it makes me feel a little sad.
character_system_text.1089:90019: Um, is there any snow on my head? …I see. Phoo. Hats are truly great inventions…
character_system_text.1089:91000: I need to return Kitasan's handkerchief… But she's always surrounded by people… Going through that crowd… Uugh…!
character_system_text.1089:91001:
Calling me "Fishing Master"…
Dia seems to think a bit too
highly of me…
character_system_text.1089:91002: Crown's reviews are so well written… Haah… I'd really like to try those Hong Kong steamed buns too…
character_system_text.1089:91003: I want to play catch… but the idea of having to talk… haah. I'll just play with the wall again…
character_system_text.1089:91004: This morning's sports paper had another huge article about my sister… Haah, how can the gap be this big…?
character_system_text.1089:91005: I do want to be number one, but… haah. Standing in the center of the stage… Am I really cut out for that…?
character_system_text.1089:91006:
D-Do I look strange? Like these
clothes don't fit well, or this style
just isn't for me…
character_system_text.1089:91007:
This cape looks beautiful no
matter how many times I see it…
It's like glowing, shimmering
plankton.
character_system_text.1089:91008:
I don't mind standing out when
I'm wearing this, for once. In a
positive way… it feels like I'm
someone different.
character_system_text.1089:91009:
Duramente was first to morning
practice again. …I should wake
up earlier as well.
character_system_text.1089:91010:
Earth was playing even over
lunch break. She really loves
music, doesn't she. …She had
such a lovely timbre, too.
character_system_text.1089:91011:
Homework is done, textbooks are
ready for tomorrow. Now I just
have to sleep… Hmm, maybe I'll
double-check everything.
character_system_text.1089:91012: I-I caught a really big black seabream recently…! Ah… um… T-That's all I wanted to say…
character_system_text.1089:91013:
The swimsuit Vivlos gave me…
What do I do…!? I can't wear
such a vibrant, frilly thing…!
character_system_text.1089:91014:
It's spring in Australia, isn't it…
If I send a picture of the autumn
leaves to my childhood friend
over there, they'd be so
surprised…
character_system_text.1089:91015: Meat buns in winter… taste especially delicious. Steaming hot in the cold weather… Hwaa～
character_system_text.1089:91016:
I share quite a few interests with
Shion… Like being a dog person,
or liking sports manga…
character_system_text.1089:91017:
I don't want to be the one who's
always helped… I want to help
Crown too… Maybe with fishing
or baseball…
character_system_text.1089:91018:
Vivlos, I swear… First swimsuits,
now dresses and "celebrity
sisters"…? I'm at my limit. No.
Absolutely, NO!
character_system_text.1089:91019:
Duramente… It's not that she
was bad at fishing… She just
struggled to restrain her power.
It was… kind of cute…
character_system_text.1089:91020: Ai always looks me straight in the eyes when she talks… Uugh, she's just too much for me…!
character_system_text.1089:91021:
The scent of the sea?
Ah… it's because this morning,
I went to the beach to train.
The sea breeze… felt really nice.
character_system_text.1089:91022: The cafeteria's special menu tomorrow is… Sichuan, hmmh. It will be a scramble… b-but, I'll try my best…?
character_system_text.1089:91023: I fell asleep last night with my stomach exposed… Uugh… I ended up showing Shion such an embarrassing side of me…
character_system_text.1089:91024: Flower viewing… There will definitely be tons of people… but Kitasan went out of her way to invite me… Uugh… what should I do…
character_system_text.1089:91025:
Sparklers really are… best on
the beach. The smell of the sea
and gunpowder, the tiny light
illuminating the sand… It's nice…
character_system_text.1089:91026: I ate too much… of the autumn delicacies. Uugh… I'll go to the batting cages to work off my fat…
character_system_text.1089:91027: My parents sent me a belly warmer so I don't catch a cold. It's just, um… the cutesy puppy pattern is a bit…
character_system_text.1089:91028:
This sweatshirt is the only
thing I chose myself. So, you
c-complimenting it… made me
really happy…!
character_system_text.1089:91029:
The nail polish on my toes
chipped… Should I ask Vivlos
or Crown again…? N-No, this
time I'll try doing it myself!
character_system_text.1089:92000:
Are my sisters training too?
…Hmm, no, it doesn't matter.
Focus!
character_system_text.1089:92001:
Can we increase the training
intensity a bit more…? I'm still
not seeing results…
character_system_text.1089:92002: Um… If there's anything you notice, could you please point it out…?
character_system_text.1089:92003:
…I need to burn off
the snacks I ate.
character_system_text.1089:92005:
H-How do I look now?
Have I grown a little…?
character_system_text.1089:92006:
Having you here, Trainer,
makes me feel at ease… I can
move forward without worry.
character_system_text.1089:92007: Um… thank you. Thank you for choosing me. For becoming… my trainer.
character_system_text.1089:92011: The sand… feels so nice… Uh, focus, focus…!
character_system_text.1089:92015:
I might not be like the sun, but
I'll burn with fighting spirit too…
L-Let's go!
character_system_text.1089:92016:
I brought lots of sports drinks
to prevent dehydration and salt
loss. …D-Did I bring too many?
character_system_text.1089:92017:
Be bolder, like this swimsuit…
I wonder what… bold training
would look like…?
character_system_text.1089:92018:
Duramente taught me
a warm-up routine. Can I…
try it out for a bit…?
character_system_text.1089:92020:
You're so open-minded and
warm… Just like the summer sea.
Maybe that's why I can say what
I'm thinking…
character_system_text.1089:92021: Maybe it's true… wearing a swimsuit really does make you more open… I want to try my best at various things with you, Trainer…
character_system_text.1089:92022: Even if my efforts amounts to nothing… compared to my old self who couldn't muster any courage, I'm prouder of who I am now.
character_system_text.1089:93000:
Thank you… my grand
and wonderful Trainer.
character_system_text.1089:93001:
My strong points… You've taught
me so much about them.
character_system_text.1089:93004:
Next season… and further into
the future… I want to keep moving
forward with you, Trainer…
character_system_text.1089:93005:
Riding the waves together…
is how we made it here.
character_system_text.1089:95001: I never knew I had it in me…!
character_system_text.1089:95003: I'm Cheval Grand. Um… pleased to meet you.
character_system_text.1089:95004:
I can't stay in my shell anymore…
I am a great Umamusume too…!
character_system_text.1089:95005:
I must become someone
who can be of use…
character_system_text.1089:95006:
I-If there's anything
I can help with…!
character_system_text.1089:95008:
The power of a swimsuit…
seems really formidable…
character_system_text.1089:95009:
B-Be a little… bolder…
No no no, I just can't do it…!
character_system_text.1089:95010:
Cheval… Grand…
It's not… strange, is it…?
character_system_text.1089:110000:
Trainer, what's the training
schedule for today…?
character_system_text.1089:110001:
You can learn a lot from history,
right? There might be hints on
how to get stronger…
character_system_text.1089:110002: If you're registering for a race, I would like to… Ah, i-i-if you don't mind…
character_system_text.1089:120000:
With this power, I'll become
stronger…!
character_system_text.1089:400001: The "Crispy Fried Chicken with Plum Sauce" at the restaurant here is so good… Would it be rude to order a second serving…?
character_system_text.1089:400005:
There's even an option for
offshore fishing… I'd love to try
that in my free time… Huh?
W-We can catch tuna!?
character_system_text.1089:400006:
The concert with Nature was
amazing. They all have their
own reasons for being loved,
huh… but I ——
character_system_text.1089:400007: If… I bought a bold swimsuit like that… N-No, I can't! It won't suit me! Maybe when I have more confidence… No, impossible!
character_system_text.1089:400011:
Even someone like me has fans…
I'm still not confident… but I want to… r-respond to that support.
